governance.clinical_board: National Institute of Emergency Medicine (NIEM) Clinical Protocol Board

rules.title: Chest Pain + Breathing Difficulty
rules.target_department: Emergency Triage Unit (Cath Lab on Standby)
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Chest pain = Yes AND Breathing difficulty = Yes THEN Immediate human assessment and bypass queue.
rules.description: Combined acute cardiac and respiratory distress screening indicating potential acute coronary syndrome or pulmonary embolism.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Ananya Iyer, Chief of Cardiology

rules.title: Atypical Chest Discomfort with Normal Vitals
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Chest pain = Yes AND Radiating = No AND Shortness of breath = No AND Normal vitals THEN Standard protocol with serial ECG.
rules.description: Streamlined pathway for low-risk chest discomfort cases with normal vitals and absence of radiating pain.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Rajesh Sharma, MD

rules.title: Chest Pain Radiating to Left Arm, Neck, or Jaw
rules.action: Immediate Human Escalation & Stat 12-Lead ECG Acquisition
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Chest pain = Yes AND Radiation = Yes (Left Arm / Jaw / Neck) THEN Escalate to Human Reviewer Immediately.
rules.description: Classic anginal radiation pattern carrying elevated probability of acute myocardial infarction.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Ananya Iyer, Chief of Cardiology

rules.title: Chest Pain Accompanied by Diaphoresis or Syncope
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Chest pain = Yes AND (Diaphoresis = Yes OR Syncope = Yes) THEN Trigger Immediate Resuscitation Bay.
rules.description: Autonomic symptoms accompanying chest pain indicating acute cardiogenic or vasovagal shock.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Suresh Menon, Senior Critical Care Specialist

rules.title: Pleuritic Chest Pain Aggravated by Inspiration
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Chest pain = Yes AND Pleuritic nature = Yes THEN Urgent medical evaluation for pulmonary embolism or pleuritis.
rules.description: Sharp pain aggravated by deep inspiration requiring exclusion of pulmonary embolism and pneumothorax.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Rajesh Sharma, MD

rules.title: Severe Dyspnea with Stridor or Cyanosis
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Breathing difficulty = Severe AND (Stridor = Yes OR Cyanosis = Yes) THEN Trigger Immediate Airway Alert.
rules.description: Life-threatening acute upper airway obstruction or respiratory failure.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Suresh Menon, Critical Care

rules.title: Severe Dyspnea & SpO2 < 92%
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Breathing difficulty = Yes AND SpO2 < 92% THEN Immediate clinical intervention and oxygenation.
rules.description: Critical threshold for hypoxemia detection and immediate respiratory support.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Rajesh Sharma, MD

rules.title: Acute Exacerbation of Asthma / COPD with Audible Wheeze
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Breathing difficulty = Yes AND Wheezing = Yes AND Speech intact THEN Urgent nebulization protocol.
rules.description: Moderate to severe bronchospasm in known or new respiratory disease presentations.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Priya Nair, Pulmonologist

rules.title: Inability to Speak Full Sentences (Word Dyspnea)
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Breathing difficulty = Yes AND Speech impaired (Word dyspnea) THEN Immediate High-Acuity bed.
rules.description: Marker of respiratory muscle exhaustion and imminent respiratory arrest.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Suresh Menon, Critical Care

rules.title: Mild Exertional Shortness of Breath with Normal Speech & SpO2
rules.action: Routine Vital Check & Outpatient Respiratory Evaluation
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Breathing difficulty = Mild AND SpO2 >= 95% AND Rest dyspnea = No THEN Routine clinical consultation.
rules.description: Gradual onset breathlessness without resting tachypnea or desaturation.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Priya Nair, Pulmonologist

rules.title: Fever with Altered Mental State or Stiff Neck (Meningism)
rules.action: Immediate Lumbar Puncture Pathway & Stat Antibiotics
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Fever = Yes AND (Altered sensorium = Yes OR Neck stiffness = Yes) THEN Immediate sepsis/meningitis escalation.
rules.description: Suspected bacterial meningitis or viral encephalitis requiring stat parenteral antimicrobial therapy.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Rajesh Sharma, MD

rules.title: Fever with Hemodynamic Instability or Septic Shock Signs
rules.action: Sepsis Bundle (< 1 Hour Protocol) & Human Review
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Fever = Yes AND (BP Systolic < 90 OR HR > 120 OR Extreme rigors = Yes) THEN Sepsis 6 Protocol.
rules.description: Severe systemic inflammatory response with end-organ hypoperfusion indicators.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Suresh Menon, Critical Care

rules.title: High Fever in Pediatric Patients (< 3 Months or Temp > 39°C)
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Fever = Yes AND (Age < 3 months OR Temperature > 39 C) THEN Urgent pediatric evaluation.
rules.description: Rapid escalation protocol for high temperature readings or febrile young infants.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Kavita Narayanan, Head of Pediatrics

rules.title: Uncomplicated Low-Grade Fever with Cough/Coryza
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Fever = Low-grade AND Duration < 3 days AND No red flags THEN Ambulatory general medicine clinic.
rules.description: Benign viral syndrome presentation with stable hemodynamics and no focal neurological or hemodynamic deficits.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Rajesh Sharma, MD

rules.title: High-Velocity Blunt Trauma or Penetrating Injury
rules.required_staffing: Trauma Surgeon, Emergency Physician, Orthopedic Fellow
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Injury = High velocity (RTA / Fall > 10ft) OR Penetrating wound THEN Activate Level 1 Trauma Protocol.
rules.description: Trauma registry trigger for severe physical mechanism indicators, internal hemorrhage risk, or cervical spine injury.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Vikram Sethi, Chief of Trauma Surgery

rules.title: Active Uncontrolled Arterial Hemorrhage
rules.action: Direct Pressure, Tourniquet Protocol, Stat Surgical Review
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Injury = Yes AND Active pulsing bleed = Yes THEN Direct pressure & immediate trauma team.
rules.description: Uncontrolled blood loss with risk of hemorrhagic shock within minutes.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Vikram Sethi, Chief of Trauma Surgery

rules.title: Suspected Fracture with Gross Deformity or Neurovascular Deficit
rules.action: Immediate Splinting, Neurovascular Check & Stat Radiography
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Injury = Limb deformity OR Pulseless extremity THEN Urgent reduction & imaging protocol.
rules.description: Dislocated joints or deformed long bone fractures with risk of compartment syndrome.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Arvind Swaminathan, Senior Orthopedic Consultant

rules.title: Head Injury with Loss of Consciousness or Vomiting
rules.action: C-Spine Immobilization & Urgent Non-Contrast Head CT
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Head injury = Yes AND (LOC = Yes OR Repeated vomiting = Yes) THEN Canadian CT Head Rule Urgent Scan.
rules.description: Concussion red flags requiring radiological exclusion of intracranial hemorrhage.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Vikram Sethi, Chief of Trauma Surgery

rules.title: Minor Laceration with Controlled Bleeding
rules.target_department: Emergency Fast Track / Minor Treatment Room
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Injury = Superficial laceration AND Bleeding controlled AND Neurovascular intact THEN Fast Track suturing.
rules.description: Clean superficial skin cut suitable for primary closure under local anesthesia.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Rajesh Sharma, MD

rules.title: Isolated Minor Ankle or Wrist Sprain
rules.action: RICE Therapy, Weight-bearing Assessment, Plain Radiograph
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Injury = Minor twist/sprain AND Ottawa rules negative THEN Standard ice, bandage, analgesia.
rules.description: Ambulatory patient with localized joint tenderness following low-energy twisting.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Arvind Swaminathan, Senior Orthopedic Consultant

rules.title: Sudden Severe 'Tearing' Abdominal or Back Pain
rules.action: Immediate Vascular Surgeon Alert & Stat CT Angiogram
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Abdominal pain = Sudden severe tearing OR Hypotension present THEN Rule out Ruptured AAA / Aortic Dissection.
rules.description: High-risk presentation for leaking abdominal aortic aneurysm or mesenteric ischemia in older adults.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Ananya Iyer, Chief of Cardiology

rules.title: Rigid / Board-like Abdomen with Involuntary Guarding
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Abdominal pain = Yes AND Rigidity/Rebound tenderness = Yes THEN Stat Acute Abdomen Surgical Call.
rules.description: Signs of visceral perforation or widespread intra-abdominal sepsis.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Sunita Deshmukh, Head of General Surgery

rules.title: Acute Right Lower Quadrant Pain with Fever
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Abdominal pain = RLQ / McBurney's AND (Fever = Yes OR Nausea = Yes) THEN Urgent Alvarado surgical protocol.
rules.description: Appendicitis diagnostic pathway leveraging localized abdominal tenderness, rebound sign, and systemic fever.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Sunita Deshmukh, Head of General Surgery

rules.title: Mild Diffuse Cramping with Normal Bowel Sounds
rules.deterministic_logic: IF Abdominal pain = Mild diffuse AND No guarding AND Normal vitals THEN Outpatient symptomatic care.
rules.description: Mild crampy discomfort without peritoneal signs, high fever, or hemodynamic instability.
rules.approved_by: Dr. Rajesh Sharma, MD
